default.notes: A Cypriot national short-stay visa is required, from the Cypriot mission serving your place of residence. Holders of a valid double- or multiple-entry Schengen visa already used in the Schengen Area can generally enter without a separate Cypriot visa.

groups.notes: EU citizens can enter Cyprus with a passport or national ID card and stay without a visa; register if staying over 3 months.
EEA and Swiss citizens enjoy free movement equivalent to EU citizens.
90 days in any 180-day period. Cyprus is EU but not Schengen, so these days do not count against the Schengen 90/180 allowance. ETIAS will cover Cyprus once mandatory.

CY.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Cypriot citizens.

UA.notes: Visa-free with a biometric passport: 90 days in any 180-day period, under Cyprus's alignment with the EU visa-free list.

RU.notes: Cyprus suspended visa facilitation for Russian citizens in line with EU policy — a Cypriot national visa from a Cypriot mission is required, with higher fees and slower processing.

VU.notes: In line with the EU's suspension of Vanuatu's visa waiver over its citizenship-by-investment scheme, a Cypriot national visa is required.
